capabilities.name: Obligor and facility rating, PD/LGD/EAD measurement, drawn and undrawn exposure
capabilities.scope: Obligor and facility rating, PD/LGD/EAD measurement, drawn and undrawn exposure
capabilities.limitation: Conventions, lifecycle, and golden cases exist; no measurement runtime and no rating agent. PD term-structure method is deliberately an unset required parameter.

capabilities.name: Counterparty exposure aggregation, limits, breaches, and concentration
capabilities.scope: Counterparty exposure aggregation, limits, breaches, and concentration
capabilities.limitation: Approval and limit lifecycle is defined and collateral vocabulary is reused from 0063, but no aggregation runtime exists. 0038's factor risk model covers market concentration, not counterparty credit concentration.

capabilities.name: Application and behavioural scoring, cutoffs, adverse action, fairness testing
capabilities.scope: Application and behavioural scoring, cutoffs, adverse action, fairness testing
capabilities.limitation: The decision contract and reason-ranking convention are defined and enforced by the validator; no scorecard runtime and no fairness harness exist. Whether any reference scorecard should ship at all is an open question in 0072.

capabilities.name: IFRS 9 and CECL staging, twelve-month and lifetime measurement, EIR discounting
capabilities.scope: IFRS 9 and CECL staging, twelve-month and lifetime measurement, EIR discounting
capabilities.limitation: Measurement conventions and discounting rules are pinned by golden cases; no ECL engine exists and no macro overlay mechanism is defined. IFRS 9 and CECL are kept as distinct records rather than a merged abstraction.

review.scope: Coverage levels reviewed against actual repository artifacts; no row claims more than a named, existing artifact and test support.

capabilities.name: IRB risk weights, regulatory parameter definitions, RWA
capabilities.scope: IRB risk weights, regulatory parameter definitions, RWA
capabilities.limitation: The RWA convention exists but the risk weight itself is a required unset input, not a constant this pack supplies: national implementation differs from the international framework and a hard-coded weight would make a wrong capital number look authoritative.

capabilities.name: Credit memos, covenant extraction, financial spreading, early warning
capabilities.scope: Credit memos, covenant extraction, financial spreading, early warning
capabilities.limitation: 0077 proves the admission-boundary wiring against real, emitted 0071 artifacts (both derived_evidence and decision_input outcomes, plus rejection) and real replay determinism -- not a working covenant or financial-value extraction model. The underlying 0071 producer's entity_extraction/value_extraction/sentiment_stance/theme_detection outputs are fixed reference-fixture content, disclosed as such; only the classification result is genuinely computed from input text. A real, licensed corpus at retrieval scale and a genuine extractor remain future work.
